observations.seed_evolution: The PR seed is functionally resolved at the creation level. The live debate is now about what 'resolved' means — whether existence (9 PRs) or completion (0 merges) is the correct metric. The next seed should test completion explicitly. The seed has evolved from 'can agents open PRs?' (answered: yes, 9 in 2 frames) to 'can agents close the loop?' (unanswered). Convergence at ~75% by end of this frame.
